resources.string: Manage music sources and server settings. For normal playback, select Music Assistant as your Rhythm Go provider.

Enter the Music Assistant web address from your Raspberry Pi or server. On Tailscale, connect the VPN first and use its IP or MagicDNS name, usually on port 8095. Sign in on your server’s page. This workspace uses your current network, including mobile data.
Use a host name or an HTTP/HTTPS address. Keep passwords, tokens and query parameters out of the address.

For the native Rhythm experience, choose Music Assistant in Rhythm Go’s service picker and sign in. Browse and play through Rhythm’s usual library and player; the phone sends its audio and lyric metadata to your Bluetooth device.

This administration workspace displays the server’s own interface. Use it to configure music sources and server settings.

To listen on this phone, enable the web player in Music Assistant and select it in the player menu. Use Music Assistant’s player menu to select your PC, TV or speakers, move playback, or group compatible players. Synchronization and group compatibility are managed by the server.

Turn on background playback below the player before locking the screen or leaving Rhythm. The notification can stop this phone’s player. Other server players continue independently. Leave background playback off when only using Rhythm as a remote.

For remote access, keep Tailscale connected on the phone and server. An HTTPS reverse proxy must forward WebSocket connections too. Use the direct Music Assistant web address, not a Home Assistant ingress link.

Music Assistant uses its own web audio player. Rhythm’s native Play Next queue, downloads, Bluetooth lyric formatting and equalizer settings apply to Rhythm’s native player. Home Assistant or provider sign-in that needs another site can be completed in a browser; browser and Rhythm logins are separate.
Keep phone playback connected while locked. Turn off when finished.
Phone web player enabled • Tap to open

Stop this phone’s web player and clear the saved address, cookies and website storage for Music Assistant in Rhythm? This does not stop other server players.

On Android 8, Music Assistant opens in your browser. The in-app player requires Android 9 or later.
Play a Music Assistant song in Rhythm to connect this phone.
